# aibris v0.12.2

This patch release completes the Windows native install and path-handling
foundation, collecting 6 commits since v0.12.1 (2026-09-21). All changes are
Windows-specific improvements; Unix behavior and the CLI/JSON surface remain
unchanged.

## Highlights

- **Native Windows installer**: PowerShell `install.ps1` downloads, verifies,
  and installs the Windows zip without Bash or admin privileges (#556)
- **Windows path canonicalization**: Case-insensitive path handling enables
  proper worktree discovery and recorded-cwd classification on Windows (#557)
- **Test infrastructure**:
  - First-use reproduction fixtures for native Windows workflows (#555)
  - Scan-to-dry-run classification contract tests (#559)
  - Fixed PowerShell test timeouts on `windows-safety` CI (#558)
- **Documentation**: WINDOWS.md quick start section for install→scan→preview
  workflow (#560)

## Compatibility impact

- [x] **No compatibility change.** Documented CLI flags, JSON fields,
  defaults, and exit behavior are unchanged.

CLI surface, JSON schema version (`1`), and default behavior remain
identical to v0.12.1. All changes are Windows-specific internal improvements
or test infrastructure.

## Upgrade and migration

No flag migration is required.

```bash
brew upgrade aibris
# or (Unix):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.sh | bash -s -- v0.12.2
# or (Windows PowerShell):
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Existing `scan --json` / `clean --json` consumers are unaffected.

## Safety

All v0.12.1 safety guarantees remain unchanged:

- `plain-dir` and mixed-marker owners stay review-only
- Active worktrees, live agent state, and current working directory are protected
- `--apfs-snapshots` stays opt-in (macOS only)
- Default `clean --json` output stays path-redacted

Windows path canonicalization improves safety by:
- Correctly matching case-insensitive paths on Windows (e.g., `C:\Users` vs `c:\users`)
- Enabling proper worktree discovery and recorded-cwd validation on Windows
- Maintaining exact case-sensitivity on Unix without regression

## Windows status

Windows native support is now **installable and reproducible**:

- **PowerShell installer**: `install.ps1` installs verified zip into user
  prefix (`$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\aibris` by default) without
  requiring Bash or administrator privileges. It verifies SHA-256 checksums,
  preserves existing binaries on error, and supports custom install paths.
- **Path handling**: Windows path operations use case-insensitive canonical
  comparison (lowercase normalization), enabling worktree discovery and
  agent-state classification to work correctly with Windows filesystem
  semantics.
- **CI coverage**: `windows-safety` CI exercises native `aibris.exe` build,
  isolated first-use fixtures, install tests, scan→dry-run classification
  contracts, and path canonicalization.

**Still experimental / unmeasured**:
- Real vendor agent worktree layouts (Codex/Claude/Cursor containers) on Windows
- End-to-end delete mutation (only dry-run planning is CI-verified)
- Native arm64 execution (arm64 archive is cross-built only)

See `docs/WINDOWS.md` for complete Windows install instructions, tested
surfaces, and known gaps.

## Verification

Pre-tag verification passed `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and the
Windows-status validator. PR CI will verify all checks (ubuntu-latest,
macos-latest, windows-safety, release-build) pass. The tagged release workflow
will publish the six Darwin/Linux/Windows archives, `checksums.txt`, SPDX
SBOMs, GitHub attestations, and the tap Formula update.
